Overview

Laredo is a city in TX with a population of 264,069. Border city with Mexican culture, international trade, and the cheapest living in Texas. Housing is more affordable than the national average. The overall cost of living is below the national average. Gardening thrives here — the 9a growing zone supports Warm to hot — citrus, tropical fruits, year-round growing. The population skews young, with a median age of 29.7.
